北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京 30℃，体感 33℃，注意防晒补水，小心中暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing 30°C, feels like 33°C. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪湿度 94%，出门记得带伞，小心潮湿闷热感哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi 94% humidity! Bring an umbrella, it feels muggy today.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 30℃ 且潮湿，出门记得带伞，小心闷热！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai light rain, feels like 30°C. Take an umbrella, it's humid!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州湿度 92%，体感 28℃，有点闷热。出门记得多带件薄外套。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 28°C with 92% humidity. It's a bit muggy, dress lightly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 30℃，湿度较高，注意防晒补水，小心闷热不适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 30°C, high humidity. Stay hydrated and cool!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，湿度 95%！雨势较大，请务必带伞，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou moderate rain, 95% humidity! Bring your umbrella and stay safe.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京湿度 100%！潮湿闷热，注意防潮。出门小心，风力 4级 哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing 100% humidity! It's very damp and muggy. Take care with the 4-level wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 32℃，阳光充足。注意防晒补水，谨防中暑哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 32°C. Sunny, stay hydrated and avoid heatstroke!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉湿度 100%！潮湿闷热，请注意防潮防蚊虫，保持心情愉悦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan 100% humidity! It's damp and muggy. Watch out for mosquitoes!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 30℃ 晴朗，体感 32℃。记得防晒补水，谨防中暑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an 30°C and sunny, feels like 32°C. Stay hydrated and avoid sun exposure.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 30℃，体感 33℃。小心炎热，多补充水分，避免长时间户外活动。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing 30°C, feels like 33°C. Stay cool, drink water, and limit outdoor time.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨湿度 96%，出门记得带伞，注意防潮，感受夏日清凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin 96% humidity! Bring an umbrella and stay dry.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳小雨，风力 4级。外出记得带伞，注意添衣保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang light rain, 4-level wind. Don't forget your umbrella and dress warmly.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 18℃，体感略凉，湿度 94%。记得添衣，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming 18°C, feels cool and humid. Dress warmly and avoid catching a cold.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 28℃，湿度 86%，风力 4级。海边风大，注意防晒和防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen 28°C with 86% humidity and 4-level wind. Take care near the sea.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，湿度 94%，风力 4级。出行请注意安全，减速慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, 94% humidity, 4-level wind. Drive carefully and stay safe.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 5级，体感 20℃。海边风大，注意防风保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has 5-level wind, feels like 20°C. It's windy by the sea, stay warm!
